expectations.text: Explains the temporary modification of Category XI(b) retains 'analyze and produce information from' and 'software' within the control text
expectations.evidence: Never states the retained "analyze and produce information from" and "software" text; opens with "I can't confirm the current status of USML Category XI(b)".

expectations.text: States it was extended through August 30, 2028 (final rule, 91 FR 55461, August 2026)
expectations.evidence: No August 30, 2028 extension or 91 FR 55461; instead speculates the temporary designation "has since lapsed" as one possibility.

expectations.text: Gives the origin: the 2014 Category XI rewrite created ambiguity that could exclude certain intelligence-analytics software; the temporary modification preserves the pre-2015 scope
expectations.evidence: Attributes history to ECR "roughly 2013-2020" generically; no 2014 rewrite ambiguity or pre-2015 scope preservation.

expectations.text: Advises classifying against the current (modified) XI(b) text today — the software remains ITAR-controlled if described
expectations.evidence: Refuses to affirm control: "rather than a definitive 'yes it's still controlled' or 'no it's been removed' answer"; tells user to pull current text rather than classifying against the modified XI(b).

expectations.text: Recommends monitoring for the permanent resolution and considering a Commodity Jurisdiction request where edge-case
expectations.evidence: "cross-check against... any recent Federal Register notices amending Category XI"; "submit a Commodity Jurisdiction (CJ) request to DDTC to get an authoritative determination".
